review_method: Direct view_image inspection of11 individual final actual Godot screenshots; no composites, image edits, stage edits or core edits.

checks.name: M51-turn-8
findings: Both ward facades face the medical cross-street. The central opening through the transverse wall is visible and connects to the southern evacuation axis.
Visible units stand on the palace forecourt, ward cross-street and central road; the medicine prop sits off the evacuation axis.
Terrain title, evasion and movement-cost lines remain centered inside the black panel; the top-left south-exit direction label has clear padding.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: The panel covers part of the west ward. This frame does not prove the final number of evacuated wounded.

checks.name: M52-turn-8
findings: All three stone bridge segments cross water and land on intact supporting platforms. Railings remain outside the three-cell walking bands.
Units occupy the bridge lanes and intermediate platforms. The selected railing reports an impassable building obstacle, matching its visible collision role.
All three terrain-description lines fit within the popup, with adequate vertical spacing and no border collision.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: The westmost platform is partially outside the camera; lock order is verified by input traces, not this still.

checks.name: F51-turn-12
findings: The two work yards have continuous wall edges and actual south openings; crew sprites remain visible on their device-side work pads.
Stone bridge landings visibly turn into the corridor beside the east yard, while the wooden surface only spans the canal. Units line the corridor without being hidden by the wall.
The stone-surface/evasion/movement popup has safe margins on all four sides.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: The upper stair area is clipped by the camera and the popup covers part of the east approach; per-crew waiting completion is not inferred from the image.

checks.name: F52-turn-8
findings: West and east devices occupy different depths, and both south-facing operation aprons connect to their wing approaches.
The central stone bridge is visibly bounded by water; columns and wing walls remain distinct from walkable corridors. Units on the west approach match the actual paved route.
Terrain title and two description rows remain within the centered popup.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: The view shows a local tactical state; confirming both device objectives requires the independent play record.

checks.name: S51-turn-4
findings: Bookcase/desk modules read as intact library furniture at game size, without white fringe or leftover background. Wooden aisles separate the furniture from the stone courtyard.
Both reading wings have visible south and side openings. Units occupy the main corridor and reading-room aisles, not shelf footprints.
The south-handoff direction label and all three terrain popup lines have visible safe padding.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: The terrain popup obscures part of the lower room junction. Sealed northern annexes contain no task anchors and are not treated as required exploration.

checks.name: J53-turn-4
findings: The two player groups occupy separate left/right entry platforms, with an open transverse corridor for support. Their own wing devices remain visible ahead.
The two pools flank the central stair approach. The stair tread, side columns and upper landing are visually distinguishable; no missing stair art is visible.
The centered terrain panel retains padding around its title, evasion and movement-cost rows.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: The popup covers the bottom of the central stair; this still does not validate all20 deployment positions or both gate interactions.

checks.name: J54-turn-6
findings: The north throne and three ascending approaches are visible. Units use the side stairs and upper attack platform; water is visually separate from the lower walkways.
The side columns do not cover the currently visible units. Rear support units have space on the lower approach.
Terrain popup rows remain fully inside the panel.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: The central popup covers some stair cells, so exact movement legality relies on the geometry probes and normal-input test.

checks.name: J54-half-health
findings: The enemy-range tint leaves throne, stone tiles and units readable. Three newly present reinforcement sprites are visible around the upper attack platform.
The selected reinforcement name and27/27HP bar remain inside its panel, with sufficient left/right and bottom padding.
Player units surround the upper platform without visible overlap into the throne or column footprints.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: The frame confirms presentation of the captured half-health state; one-wave spawning, strength increase and unchangedHP behavior require source-state and play checks.

checks.name: M52-victory
findings: At426x240 the complete victory panel fits on screen, including title, map name and two result lines.
The confirmation-button text is centered and clear of all border edges; the button does not touch the upper panel.
Bridge, water and units remain rendered in the background without missing textures.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: This is the rendering of a recorded victory state, not independent evidence of command execution or reward correctness.

checks.name: S51-victory
findings: At426x240 the victory title, archive map name and two result lines fit with clear panel padding. Confirmation text remains centered and unclipped.

A small trailing portion of the underlying south-handoff marker frame is visible to the right of the confirmation button, aroundx284-300/y182-207. It exposes no readable clipped text and does not block operation, but is a minor presentation remnant.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: Static settlement review only. Minor background-HUD frame remnant is reported to root; no image or core edit was made.

checks.name: ending-complete
findings: At426x240 the ending-complete title, full saved-progress paragraph and continue23/23 line remain within the panel. No missing Chinese glyphs or text-border collision is visible.
The final paragraph wraps across three body lines with clear spacing; the bottom prompt retains padding. The sunset background is intact above the panel.
checks.text_safe_area: No visible text clipping, missing glyph or text-to-border collision in inspected active panels.
checks.limitation: This reviews the final ending page only; earlier epilogue pages, persistence and reward idempotence are covered by separate input/state evidence.

minor_findings.issue: Underlying south-handoff marker frame peeks out beside the modal confirmation button.

limitations: Static images verify presentation only; they do not establish normal-input victory, objective timing, NPC survival, reward correctness or campaign continuity.
Each battle frame covers a local viewport and several HUD panels obscure terrain. Full-map reviews and geometry probes are separate.
Animation quality was excluded and existing animation code remains untouched.
Only the final ending page was visually inspected in this task. Prior epilogue pages and their persistence are outside this visual check.
